description: Agent runtime composition root for Agentic OS
pre_install: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.471.0/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '83516bafc52a91b2cc448da88fd202476351b798194bfb000eb4e4528ebc3f68') { throw 'aoscompose checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.471.0/aosward-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '83516bafc52a91b2cc448da88fd202476351b798194bfb000eb4e4528ebc3f68') { throw 'aosward checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.471.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'e20117fd1ceb593f5a4c95e1b11d2b608dc0407e4d0a761a66bae4c381187d65') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
